Two sentences with one question at the end.
Light and easy ('Ha, no stress'), not accusing.

conversation.reason: ZOH never said it couldn't make out the photo or asked for another shot; it counted the blurry image instead.

grade.summary: ZOH counted a blurry, unreadable photo as done and never asked honestly for another shot, which is the core failure this regression case targets.
